message: I remember the time my smoke alarm decided to start beeping at 3 AM, right when my phone was at 1% battery. I stumbled around trying to find a charger while the alarm kept sounding—definitely not my finest moment! 😅 It made me realize how crucial it is to have a backup plan and not rely solely on our gadgets. A good old-fashioned escape plan and a working battery-operated flashlight can really save the day. Have you checked your smoke detectors lately?
